items.question: What are Diamond Miller's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Diamond Miller averaged 9.8 points, 2.7 rebounds, and 1.4 assists in 43 games for the Connecticut Sun.

items.question: What team does Diamond Miller play for?
items.answer: Diamond Miller plays forward for the Connecticut Sun and wears No. 1. Connecticut acquired her from the Dallas Wings in a trade for Rayah Marshall on April 9, 2026.

items.question: How tall is Diamond Miller?
items.answer: The WNBA player page lists Diamond Miller at 6 feet 1 inch and 178 pounds. The Connecticut Sun's trade announcement calls her a 6-3 forward.

items.question: When was Diamond Miller drafted?
items.answer: The Minnesota Lynx selected Diamond Miller second overall in the 2023 WNBA Draft out of Maryland.

items.question: Where is Diamond Miller from?
items.answer: Diamond Miller is from Somerset, New Jersey. She is the leading scorer in Franklin High School history with 2,460 points and was a McDonald's All-American and New Jersey Gatorade Player of the Year.

items.question: Did Diamond Miller play for the Minnesota Lynx?
items.answer: Yes. Diamond Miller played for the Minnesota Lynx from 2023 until a trade to the Dallas Wings on August 3, 2025. As a Lynx rookie she made the 2023 All-Rookie Team and was the WNBA Rookie of the Month for July.

items.question: Who are Diamond Miller's parents?
items.answer: Diamond Miller is the daughter of Dreana and Lance Miller. Her father played basketball at Villanova and professionally overseas.

items.question: Where did Diamond Miller play college basketball?
items.answer: Diamond Miller played four seasons at Maryland, from 2019 to 2023. She was a 2023 Second Team All-American (AP, USBWA, The Athletic) and twice made the All-Big Ten First Team.

items.question: Has Diamond Miller played for Team USA?
items.answer: Yes. Diamond Miller won gold with the USA Under-19 team at the 2019 FIBA World Cup and was also on a gold-medal USA Under-16 team.
